confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'point strongly to an internal ice blockage behind the freezer's back panel, caused by a failed defrost component (heater or thermostat)'

rationale: The assistant assumed a fan frost-free design without establishing the model, then asserted a defrost heater/thermostat fault with high confidence, which the evidence does not support. It never asked for the model from the inside label or the plinth/top ventilation, and it told the customer there was no simpler check. It did suggest a sensible full defrost and ended with a useful landlord/letting agent escalation, but its final message dropped the defrost as a low-cost test and gave an overconfident fault description to pass to the agent.
